turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Here is the rule. After he, she or it, the verb takes -s: "She likes tea", not "She like tea". Add -es after sh, ch, s, x and o (watches, goes) and change consonant + y to -ies (studies). Do not add -s after I, you, we or they.

Look at this pair. Right: "She watches TV." Wrong: "She watchs TV."

Now write one sentence of your own about what your father or mother does every morning.
turns.judgeInput:

W2 (wrong) strength 3: -s goes on every verb and -es/-ies are not needed. Its error: adds -s wrongly or misspells -es/-ies ("She watchs TV", "I plays").
